verdict.rationale: Claude's own help docs describe a user-controlled Model Improvement privacy setting that governs whether chats are used to improve Claude. Incognito chats are excluded from training even when that setting is on, and Google Workspace connector data is never used for training. missing for 10: step-by-step docs on where and how to toggle the Model Improvement setting and its default state, explicit opt-out language, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models

citations.quote: Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your privacy settings.
When you allow us to use your chats or coding sessions to help improve Claude, we implement several layers of protection for your privacy.
We do not train our models on your Gmail, Drive, or Calendar connector data, ensuring your private information remains private.
